paragraphs: Welcome to Solace Aesthetics. By booking an appointment, using our services, or purchasing through our website, you agree to the following terms and conditions. These terms are designed to ensure a professional, respectful and safe experience for all clients.

sections.heading: 1. Appointments and Bookings
paragraphs: - Appointments can be made online, by phone, or in person.
- A deposit or prepayment may be required for certain services to confirm your booking.
- Please arrive on time for your appointment. Late arrivals may result in reduced treatment time to avoid impacting the next clients booking.
- If you are more than 10 minutes late, your appointment may need to be rescheduled and a fee may apply.

sections.heading: 2. Cancellations and No-Shows
paragraphs: We kindly ask for at least 24 hours’ notice for any appointment changes or cancellations. Cancellations with less than 24 hours’ notice, or failure to attend, may result in a cancellation fee or loss of deposit.
Repeated short-notice cancellations or missed appointments impact both our schedule and other clients’ ability to book. To ensure fairness:
-Two or more late cancellations or no-shows within a 6 month period will result in a 50% charge of the booked service/s being applied from the second occurrence onward.
-Three or more within a 6-month period will require full prepayment for future bookings. Prepaid appointments are non-refundable in the case of late cancellation or failure to attend.
We understand that unexpected situations can arise and will always consider genuine emergencies with understanding and discretion.

sections.heading: 3. Consultations and Suitability
paragraphs: Certain treatments — including electrolysis and advanced skin services — require a consultation before treatment to ensure safety, suitability and the best possible results. "
Clients must provide accurate and complete health information prior to appointment

We understand for some clients, especially those who have had electrolysis elsewhere, this requirement can feel unnecessary or frustrating. However, due to individual differences in technique, equipment and aftercare products, it is non-negotiable that a consultation takes place prior to treatment.
If a consultation has not been completed, the appointment will be rescheduled until this step has occurred.
Solace Aesthetics reserves the right to modify, postpone or decline a treatment if it is deemed unsuitable or unsafe for the client.

sections.heading: 4. Payment and Pricing
paragraphs: - All prices are listed in New Zealand dollars (NZD) and include GST unless stated otherwise.
-Payment is required at the time of treatment unless prior arrangements have been made.
-Prices are subject to change without notice, though confirmed bookings will be honored at the agreed rate.

sections.heading: 5. Promotions
paragraphs: Promotional offers and discounts cannot be combined unless stated otherwise

sections.heading: 6. Client Care and Responsibility
paragraphs: - Our treatments are provided with care and professionalism. Results may vary depending on individual factors such as skin type, health and home care.
-Aftercare advice will be provided following certain services — clients are encouraged to follow these recommendations for best results.
-Solace Aesthetics is not liable for adverse reactions resulting from failure to disclose medical information or to follow aftercare guidance.

sections.heading: 7. Privacy and Confidentiality
paragraphs: Your personal information is collected and stored securely in accordance with our privacy policy.
All information shared during consultations or treatments remains strictly confidential.

sections.heading: 8. Website Use
paragraphs: The content on our website is for general information only may change without notice. The Logo is property of Solace Aesthetics and may not be reproduced without permission.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: Solace Aesthetics may update these Terms of Service from time to time. The most recent version will always be available on our website.

sections.heading: 10. Contact Us
paragraphs: For questions about these terms, please contact: info@solaceaesthetics.co.nz

At Solace Aesthetics, your privacy and trust are deeply valued. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal information when you visit our website, make a booking or receive treatments at Solace.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect personal information from you when:
- Book an appointment or make an enquiry (name, contact details, relevant health information)
- Subscribe to our newsletter (name and email address)
- Purchase a product or service
- Visit our website (through cookies or analytics tools that help us improve your experience)
We collect only the information necessary to provide safe, effective and personalised care.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: Your information is used to:
- Schedule and manage appointments
- Provide professional skincare and beauty services tailored to your needs
- Communicate about bookings, promotions and updates (if you’ve opted in)
- Improve our website and client experience
- Meet legal and professional requirements
We will never sell or share your information with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: 3. Storage and Security
paragraphs: All personal information is stored securely — either electronically with password protection or in locked physical storage. We take reasonable steps to prevent loss, misuse, or unauthorized access in accordance with the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020.

sections.heading: 4. Access and Correction
paragraphs: You have the right to access and correct any personal information we hold about you. To request access or a correction, please contact us at: info@solaceaesthetics.co.nz

sections.heading: 5. Cookies and Website Analytics
paragraphs: Our website may use cookies and analytics tools to collect anonymous data about how visitors use the site. This helps us improve useability and design. You can disable cookies in your browser settings if you prefer.

sections.heading: 6. Email Communications
paragraphs: If you subscribe to our newsletter, we’ll only send you updates you’ve agreed to receive. You can unsubscribe anytime by clicking the link at the bottom of our emails.

sections.heading: 7. Updates to This Policy
paragraphs: This privacy policy may be updated from time to time to reflect our changes in our practices or legal requirements. The latest version will always be available on our website.

sections.heading: 8. Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have any questions or concerns about your privacy, please contact us at: info@solaceaesthetics.co.nz
